szoveg_eredeti:
Rocket Drew / The Information :

 California State Senator Scott Wiener, author of AI safety law SB 53, won Tuesday's election to succeed Pelosi in the US House, campaigning on AI regulation   —  Scott Wiener, the California politician who led the successful effort to pass AI safety legislation in the state's legislature last year, is headed to Washington.

prioritas.indok: A szigorú kaliforniai AI-törvény megalkotója bejutott az amerikai kongresszusba, ami szövetségi szabályozást hozhat. Forrás-tapasztalat: -3.
